title: Best AI Strategy Consultants (2026): Plan Where AI Helps
description: How to hire an AI strategy consultant to find useful AI opportunities, plan pilots and manage risks: deliverables, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: AI strategy consultants help a business decide where artificial intelligence can create real value, which projects to try first and how to manage risks like data privacy, accuracy and staff concerns. A good strategy is practical: a short list of use cases, clear pilots and simple rules for safe use. Projects go wrong when the plan is a list of buzzwords, ignores your data and processes, or recommends tools the consultant sells. This guide helps you get an AI plan you can act on.

faq.q: What will I get from an AI strategy project?
faq.a: Typically a list of use cases ranked by value and effort, a pilot plan, risk notes and simple usage guidelines.

faq.q: Do we need a strategy before using AI tools?
faq.a: Small teams can start with simple tools. A strategy helps when several teams, sensitive data or larger investments are involved.

faq.q: Will the consultant build the solutions?
faq.a: Some do; many advise only. Clarify whether implementation is included.
A good plan covers privacy, accuracy checks, security and how staff should use AI tools.
Ask whether they earn commissions from tools they recommend.
